title_sq: VILE INDIVIDUALE MODERNE PER SHITJE NE MJULL BATHORE!

title_en: MODERN INDIVIDUAL VILLA FOR SALE IN MJUL BATHORE!
description_en: In one of the most sought-after areas for the peace and clean air it offers, we offer individual villas for sale. The villa is built on a land area of ​​870 m2 and a total construction area of ​​340 m2. It consists of 2 floors plus the basement: -The basement consists of a large room which can be used as a gym, living room...etc _another room which can be used as a home cinema, wine cellar, playground...etc, also a technical room. - The ground floor consists of: Entrance corridor, large living room with a separate cooking and dining area, toilet - The 1st floor consists of 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. -Yard with 3-4 parking spaces and green environment around. The villa is sold empty. Contact me for a visit to the property.
